---
title: "NYC Weather Dashboard"
anthor: "Yutong"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
```

```{r data_cleaning, include=FALSE}
set.seed(813301)

weather_df = ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    month = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(tmax),
    !is.na(tmin),
    lubridate::year(date) >= 2010,
    lubridate::year(date) <= 2020
  ) |> 
  slice_sample(n = 5000)
```


Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Maximum vs. Minimum Temperature

```{r scatterplot}
weather_df |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin,
    y = ~tmax,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    color = ~month,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum Temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)")
  )
```

### Monthly Maximum Temperature Distribution

```{r boxplot}
weather_df |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month,
    y = ~tmax,
    type = "box",
    color = ~month
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly Average Maximum Temperature in 2010

```{r lineplot}
monthly_weather = ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month_num = lubridate::month(date)
  ) |> 
  filter(
    year == 2010,
    !is.na(tmax)
  ) |> 
  group_by(month_num) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_weather |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month_num,
    y = ~mean_tmax,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers"
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Month",
      tickmode = "linear",
      dtick = 1
    ),
    yaxis = list(tittle = "Average Maxium Temperature(°C)")
  )
```
